FULL TEXT:
CENTRAL UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU
Department of Chemistry and Chemical Sciences
Bagla (Rahya-Suchani), Samba, J&K-181143
Ref. No.CUJ/D Che/2026/ 29-07-2026
Advertisement for the post of Project Assistant (PA)
(Previous advertisement Ref. No. CUJ/D Che/2026/ 280; dated 12/05/2026)
Applications are invited for the post of Project Assistant to work in the J&K Science Technology & Innovation
Council sponsored research project in the Department of Chemistry and Chemical Sciences, Central University of
Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), District-Samba 181143, J&K.
1. Name of the Temporary Post : Project Assistant (PA)-01
2. Name of the Research
Project
: “Discovery of Selective and orally Bioavailable small molecule for the Treatment
of Triple Negative Breast Cancer”
3. Name of the Sponsoring
Agency
: JKST& IC, Jammu &Kashmir Science Technology & Innovation Council,
J&K
4 Tenure of the Project : 2Years
5 Tenure of the Assignment : 1Year (one year initially, extendable to maximum 2 years, based on the
requirement)
6 Job Description : To carry out the research work in the field of synthetic organic
Chemistry.
7. Consolidated monthly
compensation/Fellowship
: Rs.12, 000/-(consolidated).
8. Essential Qualifications and
experience
: M.Sc. Chemistry / Organic Chemistry with minimum 55% marks or
equivalent CGPA. Relaxation in % of marks are given as per GoI rules
9. Desirable Qualifications /
Experiences
10.Accommodation
11.Terms
: GATE / CSIR-UGC NET / JRF
: No accommodation will be provided.
: The services of the selected candidate will be as per University guidelines. The
project fellowship is a full-time position. The selected candidate shall not draw
money from any other source during the tenure of the project.438
12.For technical information on the project, the candidate may contact the Principal Investigator at
the following address:
Name : Dr. Indranil Chatterjee (PI)
Address : Department of Chemistry and Chemical SciencesCentral University of
Jammu, Bagla (Rahya-Suchani), Distt: Samba, J&K-181143
Telephone No : 9123928582
E-mail : indranil.che@cujammu.ac.in
Terms and Conditions:
 This temporary engagement will be for a specific period and shall automatically stand terminated with the
termination/completion of the project or earlier at the discretion of the Principal Investigator(s).
 In case the candidate leaves the assignment mid-way, without approval of PI, he/she shall be liable to pay
expenses including salary drawn till date.
 The engagements will not entitle any claim for regular employment in the University.
 Shortlisted candidate will be informed through email and called for interview.
 Shortlisted candidates shall bring the required Qualification Documents in original on day of interview.
 The candidates called for interview are not entitled to TA/DA.
 The decision of the selection committee will be final. Decision shall be communicated through email
provided.
 Tenure of the assignment for the Project Assistant post shall initially be for a period of 1 Year and may be
extended as per the requirement. However, PI reserves the right to culminate it before the said period in
case of unsatisfactory performance or as per requirement of the project.
 The application form complete in all respects along with CV, self-attested copies of qualification
certificates, and a recent passport-size photograph should reach the office of the undersigned, Department
of Chemistry and Chemical Sciences, Central University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), District
Samba–181143, J&K, either as hard copy or by email at indranil.che@cujammu.ac.in on or before 10-08-
2026. The application form can be downloaded from the University website www.cujammu.ac.in.
 The competent authority reserves the right to fill up or not to fill the vacancies notified in this
advertisement. Waiting list may also be operated if required.
 In case of selection, the candidature shall submit joining within 3 working days failing which the
candidature shall be rejected.
Sd/-
Dr. Indranil Chatterjee
Principal Investigator
